name: Direct Lighting with MIS in VolPathIntegrator
definition: A method to sample direct illumination in volumetric media by combining unidirectional path sampling and light path sampling using Multiple Importance Sampling (MIS).
summary: Direct Lighting with MIS in VolPathIntegrator reduces color noise in spectral volumetric path tracing by combining unidirectional and light path sampling strategies using Multiple Importance Sampling evaluated across all wavelengths.
